notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Capture of Jingzhou and Justiciar's Portal.
description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Justiciar's Portal by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou and Justiciar's Portal from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
